Attach: a picture appears over the box right away

The first screenshot was dropped onto the window and the second was pasted with ⌘V. Each one shows as a small picture with its name and size. Before this change you only saw “[Image #1]” as text, and ⌘V of a screenshot did nothing.

4

The model’s answer, word for word

The message asked it not to use tools. It looked at the folder once anyway, then stopped and said so.

I shouldn't have opened the folder listing, since you asked for no tools. I've stopped there and am answering from the two pictures alone. First screenshot: a map of how the Agentic Coder project folder is laid out, with the terminal part and the models part side by side and the single file each one uses to reach the other. Second screenshot: a table called "Where Qwen Lands" that puts the Qwen3.5 9B model on a benchmark table next to Gemini 4 Argon and other top models. It finds Qwen would come last on every row, and that it can't run 6 of the 19 tests in Agentic Coder on your Mac.

The two screenshots were real pages from the project’s own docs: the folder map and “Where Qwen Lands”.
